description: Synology Router Manager (SRM) CLI — device management, traffic analysis, firewall rules, mesh network monitoring, Smart WAN configuration, and Wake-on-LAN via the Synology Router REST API

auth_env_var_specs.name: SYNOLOGY_ROUTER_COOKIE_AUTH
auth_env_var_specs.description: Synology Router session cookie obtained via auth login

novel_features.name: Network Health Overview
novel_features.description: Aggregates device counts, bandwidth usage, and WAN connection status into a single health snapshot

novel_features.name: Busiest Devices
novel_features.description: Ranks devices by bandwidth consumption with percentage of total traffic

novel_features.name: Network Bottleneck Analysis
novel_features.description: Identifies devices consuming disproportionate bandwidth from combined traffic and device data

novel_features.name: Traffic Trends
novel_features.description: Day-over-day or week-over-week traffic trend analysis with rate-of-change metrics

novel_features.name: Coverage Report
novel_features.description: Shows API endpoint coverage and sync completeness per resource type

novel_features.name: Stale Resource Detection
novel_features.description: Lists synced resources older than a configurable threshold to identify stale data

novel_features.name: Network Statistics
novel_features.description: Aggregated network statistics from local store including device counts and bandwidth totals

novel_features.name: Full-text Search
novel_features.description: FTS5 full-text search across all synced router resources in the local SQLite store

novel_features.name: Offline Export
novel_features.description: Export synced router resources to stdout in JSON or JSONL format for backup and analysis
